name: Rougier S.A.
summary: Operating on a global scale, Rougier S.A. manufactures and distributes a wide array of wood-based products. The company holds approximately 2.3 million hectares of forest concessions across Gabon, Cameroon, the Republic of Congo, and the Central African Republic. Its product offerings include raw logs, milled timber (sawn timber), and plywood. Rougier S.A. also provides a variety of secondary-processed items such as decking, glued laminated scantlings, joists, finger-jointed solid blocks, and round sticks. Further expanding its portfolio, the firm supplies square-edge lumber, decorative moldings, scantlings, laminated timber products, and slabs, alongside specialized, technical, and decorative grades of plywood. Additionally, Rougier S.A. imports and sells a diverse selection of sawn timber, plywood, and other processed wood goods. Established in 1923, the company's headquarters are located in Niort, France.
